invariants.rationale: Method returns immediately unless element is null or its name is 'properties'.
Method takes MapProperties as a parameter and assumes it is not null throughout for property loading.
The for-each loop over 'element' indicates that, if not null, 'element' must be iterable (likely an array or similar).
If element is not null, its name is checked and compared, suggesting the presence of a valid name.
If element is not null, either it contains children to iterate or the iterator has no next (covers both cases).
